units.note: A chosen common coordinate scale, not a claim that Riot defines a unit as a physical centimeter.

circle.delay_interpretation: provisional cast_time + DamageDelay; runtime script order and visual cue onset unmeasured

path_radius.change: Rounded to 41 for the Survive profile.

hit_radius.note: Provisional 65; absent from downloaded champion root and possibly inherited from shared defaults. Not independently extracted from shared defaults.

visual_radius.note: Original display radius 50; geometry clearly distinguishes the 65 hit radius.

dash.warning: castRangeDisplayOverride and DataDragon range are 445, not the named MaxDistance425.

blink_range.note: Provisional actual400; official DataDragon static range425 conflicts. Keep both explicit pending extracted shared spell or video validation.

projectile.warning: The field named mMissileWidth is interpreted as collision radius70, not diameter70. DataDragon range1175 matches display override, not missile castRange1300. Cast delay.25 remains provisional because no explicit mCastTime appears on this downloaded spell.

circle.warning: Raw radius250 is adopted; secondary reported gameplay radius275 is not silently substituted. Total .75 assumes DamageDelay follows cast completion; server script evaluation and actual cue-to-hit delay remain unmeasured.

cooldown_overrides.note: Reference preset uses rank1 dash16/Flash300 without haste/refunds. Geometry remains provisional; this is not validated engine parity.

projectile_terrain.note: Selected Survive fidelity behavior: projectile passes terrain. Downloaded missile specification contains no explicit terrain-collision flag; absence does not prove runtime behavior. No official wall-crossing footage has been measured. Do not label this field raw-artifact verified.

confidence.walk_speed_cm_s: high: official versioned static value and extracted record agree
confidence.path_radius_cm: medium: named extracted record, rounded, not runtime measured
confidence.hit_radius_cm: low: secondary provisional, inherited game default unresolved
confidence.dash_range_and_speed: high artifact confidence: explicit named values in versioned extraction and DataDragon effects; runtime behavior not yet measured
confidence.dash_cast_delay_s: medium: no cast-time field and secondary description; zero is selected approximation
confidence.blink_range_cm: low: secondary400 conflicts with official static425; explicit chosen candidate
confidence.blink_cast_delay_s: medium: official description teleport plus secondary instant behavior; actual input-to-teleport not measured
confidence.projectile_speed_range: medium-high artifact confidence: explicit missile fields; source-bone offset and script endpoint may affect actual center travel
confidence.projectile_radius_cm: medium: explicit raw70; radius interpretation needs collision/video validation
confidence.projectile_cast_delay_s: low: selected .25 candidate, no explicit primary cast field found
confidence.circle_radius_cm: medium: explicit raw targeter/secondary radius, actual gameplay edge unmeasured
confidence.circle_delay_s: low: raw components known but their timing composition is an assumption
confidence.video_measurement: official unversioned Xerath W clip visually inspected; apparent ground-cue-to-main-flash interval approximately .75-.90 seconds; not input/server timing
confidence.projectile_blocked_by_terrain: provisional selected mechanic; raw specification lacks a decisive terrain flag and an official wall-crossing example has not been inspected

known_deviations: Single original character and isolated arena, no champion combat/passive/cooldown refund rules.
Practice cooldowns are shortened; reference preset restores rank1 dash16 and Flash300.
Dash wall stops, blink landing projection, command buffering and post-ability path behavior are explicit Survive rules requiring comparison before claiming fidelity.
No authoritative Riot movement engine, input replication, server tick schedule, acceleration or turn-rate model is supplied by these static artifacts.
No direct League process interaction, memory collection or Vanguard access was performed.
